metadata.title: As Broadcom’s stock falls, Wall Street focuses on the company’s forecast - MarketWatch

content.text:
As Broadcom’s stock falls, Wall Street focuses on the company’s forecast
Broadcom perhaps came up short of true ‘market expectations’ with its latest outlook, though one analyst thinks management may be taking a conservative stance on its potential
Broadcom says the market for its custom chips is expanding, but investors wanted to see that potential better reflected in near-term numbers.
A big nitpick from Broadcom’s AVGO latest earnings report was its guidance. The company expects revenue to reach $34.8 billion in the October quarter, above the $34.7 billion expected from analysts tracked by FactSet. But, according to J.P. Morgan analyst Harlan Sur, “market expectations” were actually a bit higher than that.
